entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Are we going to the Palace today?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If you want to infiltrate[n]it, I can head right over!
entries.uk: Якщо хочеш проникнути туди,[n]я можу одразу прийти!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, what do you want to do? Should[n]we meet up at the hideout and head[n]into the Palace?
entries.uk: Ну, що хочеш робити? Зберемося[n]в схованці й підемо[n]в Палац?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Got it. I'll see you[n]at the hideout.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Come on. Have you thought[n]this through?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'll be in the garden[n]on the roof for a bit.
entries.uk: Я ще трохи побуду[n]в саду на даху.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Let me know when you[n]have a plan worked out.
